[[File:Cryo_chamber.png|thumb|right|200px|Two cryo chambers]]
A '''cryogenic hibernation capsule''' or '''cryogenic chamber''' was used on [[Starship/Legends|spaceships]] as a substitute for [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tanks]]. They could be used for the transport of live cargo or to keep the critically injured stable until acceptable medical facilities were reached. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] carried a cryogenic hibernation capsule aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] to transport perishable, living, plants such as [[Shadorian assassin]] and [[Togorian dream weed]].
